prompt.zh: 关于悟空，哪一项是正确的？

choices.en: he could die in the gourd.

answer_evidence.quote: "Sun Wukong is my twin brother. My name is Sun Kongwu."
"How will I get out of here? I know I won't turn into liquid because I'm going to live forever. But I still have to save my friends."
Wukong slipped the gourd into his robe.
